description: Ex-221 Sqn MiG-23BN said to be the last MiG-23BN flown at the type's March 2009 phase-out (2145 hrs). Erected in the memorial park Dec 2009; tail carries only the digits 273 (warbirds.in, photos Chetan Chopade; Bharat Rakshak SM-273). Public memorial park.
